about

Trustat needed a promotional animation built around an existing visual concept developed with the Kringga team. The studio provided the art direction and storyboard.

I adapted the concept for animation, developing the timing, transitions, and visual flow across the sequence. I also edited the music to support the pacing and tone of the piece.
